title: Approximate scheduled general-GKLS patch channels with paid finite-bit MPOs
statement: For a connected N-qubit bounded-locality/range/incidence patch, arbitrary supplied bounded local-GKLS schedules admit a deterministic rational HP/TP MPO Upsilon with diamond error<=delta and work poly_class(B,N) exp[O_class(N^(11/12) polylog N)] when patch time is polylog N and log(1/delta)=O_class(N polylog N). Whole-GKLS CPTP deleted backgrounds support static leaves; balanced chronological merges use actual-node singular-tail certificates, O(log K log N) extra bits, growing layer dimensions/phase growth, rational Jacobi approximate isometries and coefficient-height resets. No invariant or CP output is assumed.

assumptions: The patch map is a numerical HP/TP approximation, not CP or a physical Euler/reset repair; its subexponential large-volume cost is not a global polynomial sampler. Arbitrary early transients, fixed positive nonunital threshold and higher-arity full phase remain unresolved. Signed clipping requires a SINGLE consistent mass-one signed law with global L1 control and paid prefix contractions; unrelated additive tiny-prefix estimates do not qualify. The native large-fixed-g Bell-localization transfer excludes one positive short-diameter quantum-cluster representation; it is not robust TV-sampling hardness or universal nonadaptive noisy computation. The ideal twirled Clifford/Pauli reference is stabilizer-samplable; each rational native schedule/seed average is not claimed arbitrarily accurately stabilizer-samplable. costs: Patch time<=C1 log^c1(2N), log(1/delta)<=C2 N log^c2(2N). Static complete-GKLS leaves and a balanced chronological tree have K<=S+ceil(tau_patch), O(log K log N) extra precision bits; actual layer width O(N^3/4), growing dimensions, phase growth, rational Jacobi isometries, absolute residuals and dyadic coefficient-height resets are paid. Diamond/Frobenius dimension conversions are at endpoints. B<2^N bounds log S by O(N); B>=2^N pays dense4^N-dimensional/16^N-storage evolution polynomial in B. For L=O(log(nB/epsilon)), N=O_class(L log L) costs e^O_class(L); N<=L dense children are paid, while N=Theta(L^2) is still too costly. Normalized product POVM effects have norm<=2^N, so scalar tolerance zeta needs channel error zeta2^-N. Binary hugeT uses actual unital mixing, never increases requested time. Prefix/categorical rational arithmetic uses actual numerator/denominator bits, finite draw precision R=ceil(log2(4 sum_i m_i/epsilon)), no rejection or inverse-minimum-probability runtime.
